If D > 0, two real roots; if D = 0, one repeated root; if D < 0, complex roots. Use the quadratic formula: y = [-b ± √D] / (2a). For nonhomogeneous equations, find a particular solution and add the homogeneous solution. Practice with examples to build confidence.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by identifying directions (principal components) that capture most variance. First, standardize your data.
